claim: kgateway's Inference (GIE) plugin implemented EPP-fail-open support using a 'static cluster + subset LB' workaround before Envoy's override_host LB feature was available in its pinned Envoy version.
stance_target: concrete implementation technique used in production for EPP fail-open before override_host LB existed
quoted_support: When #11810 merges, the Inference plugin will support the EppUnAvailableFailOpen conformance test. This PR uses a static cluster + subset LB to support EPP fail-open.

claim: kgateway maintainers closed the planned refactor to Envoy's override_host LB in September 2025 because the community decided to deprecate the entire Envoy-based data plane in favor of agentgateway for AI-related features, not because override_host was rejected on technical merits.
stance_target: agentgateway (not Envoy's native LB mechanisms) is the production direction for GIE-integrated non-pod destination routing in at least one major gateway implementation
quoted_support: Closing since the community decided to deprecate the Envoy-based data plane in favor of agentgateway for AI-related features.

claim: The override_host LB need for EPP-style routing was also tracked independently in Istio (istio/istio#56230) and discussed in Envoy Gateway (envoyproxy/gateway#6458), indicating the same Override-Host-vs-custom-LB-policy question recurred across multiple GIE-integrated gateway implementations.
stance_target: breadth of cross-project relevance of the override_host LB mechanism for EPP-based routing
scope_conditions: cross-project references cited in kgateway issue #11824
